name: vexiiriscv-rv32im_cached-caches
description: VexiiRiscv rv32im_cached L1s: 2 ways x 32 sets x 64-byte lines = 4 KiB each, tree PLRU (true LRU at 2 ways). The LSU L1 is write-back and allocates on a store miss.

approximations: no wrong-path fetches in the model
fixed latencies, not the RTL bus timing
